sub_graphs.title: EIP-7928: P2P Fork Version Selection
sub_graphs.description: Models how the P2P layer determines the correct fork version for message encoding and peer compatibility based on the current epoch

nodes.label: Current Epoch Determined
nodes.description: The node has computed the current epoch from the slot clock

nodes.label: Compute Fork Version
nodes.description: Evaluate the epoch against all fork epoch thresholds in descending order to select the appropriate fork version

nodes.label: EIP-7928 Fork Version Active
nodes.description: The EIP-7928 fork version is selected because epoch >= EIP7928_FORK_EPOCH

nodes.label: Prior Fork Version Active
nodes.description: A prior fork version (Fulu, Electra, Deneb, etc.) is selected because EIP7928_FORK_EPOCH has not been reached

nodes.label: Encode P2P Message with Fork Version
nodes.description: Use the determined fork version to encode gossip and request/response messages for the P2P network

edges.label: Provide current epoch for fork version lookup
Use EIP7928 fork version for message encoding

external_entities.name: Remote Peer Node
external_entities.description: A remote peer on the P2P network that sends and receives messages requiring fork-version-aware encoding

sub_graphs.title: EIP-7928: Fork Activation State Transition
sub_graphs.description: Models the state change when the network crosses the EIP-7928 fork epoch boundary

nodes.label: Pre-EIP7928 Fork State
nodes.description: Network is operating under a prior fork (e.g., Fulu) before the EIP-7928 fork epoch

nodes.label: Check Fork Epoch Boundary
nodes.description: At each epoch transition, check if the new epoch equals or exceeds EIP7928_FORK_EPOCH

nodes.label: Post-EIP7928 Fork State
nodes.description: Network is operating under EIP-7928 fork rules with updated P2P protocol behavior

ambiguities.text: The specification only describes the compute_fork_version helper modification but does not detail any new message types, topics, or validation rules specific to EIP-7928.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume that the P2P interface changes are limited to fork version selection, and all other P2P behavior is inherited from the prior fork (Fulu). This needs verification against the full EIP-7928 specification.

implicit_assumptions.description: All nodes on the network will upgrade to support EIP-7928 fork version before EIP7928_FORK_EPOCH.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Nodes running incompatible fork versions will be unable to communicate, causing network partitions and potential consensus failures.

implicit_assumptions.description: The hierarchical fork version check evaluates forks in strictly descending chronological order.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: A misordered check could cause nodes to select an incorrect fork version, leading to message encoding mismatches and peer disconnections.
